description:
Works to exterior, including re-roofing, re-facing walls and dormers, repairs to timbers, replacement glazing, and pipework as well as new door and window openings to rear elevation with partial obscure-glazed, restricted opening windows; internal works including the removal of an internal wall at ground floor to create larger kitchen, new bathrooms on first and second floors, repairs and upgrades such as additional insulation. 

Repairs to exterior, re-roofing, replacement glazing and minor internal works to a derelict Listed Building including creation of Bathroom to First Floor and Second Floor and removal of non-original wall to Ground Floor to enable creation of a larger kitchen within re-built (c1950) element of property.
